findings.message: Module instance replication_role (./modules/replication_role) has no compliancetf-manifest.json; it is listed as not-evidence, never as covered

Control s3_bucket_event_notifications_enabled is delegated to scope modules/notification of bobthecorp.compliance.tf/terraform-aws-modules/s3-bucket/aws 5.16.1-1e4b692ae5e0a847; no instantiated module instance governs that scope, so this configuration has no evidence the control is enforced; the control catalog 2026.11.1 does not hold this control id (the embedded catalog holds the CIS v6.0 controls only; name a full catalog with --catalog), so the finding carries no control id
